mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in non-farm payrolls below 130,000 thousand persons indicates worsening labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in >60% of instances when PAYEMS < 130,000 thousand, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% signals aggressive monetary policy easing that reduces risk-free rates and equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of triggered instances, or the signal fails to outperform baseline returns in t-tests (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production below 85 and unemployment rate above 9.5% indicate severe economic contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce negative returns in >60% of instances, or the interaction effect is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 600 thousand units during post-crisis recovery periods indicate weak consumer demand, causing negative equity returns as housing sector weakness spreads to broader consumption.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST < 600, or the signal's predictive power vanishes in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 85 index points reflects manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate output and profit margins, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 85, or the signal's Rank IC drops below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Gross domestic product growth below 1% annualized rate indicates weak economic activity that suppresses corporate revenue growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when GDPC1 growth < 1%, or the signal's predictive accuracy falls below 55% in walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% during recessionary periods signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase corporate cost pressures and reduce consumer spending, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances, or the signal's correlation with returns drops below 0.15 in rolling 3-year periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer price inflation below 215 and federal funds rate below 0.2% indicate accommodative monetary policy that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive returns in >60% of instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
